r.name: Clumber Park History Walk, Clumber Park
r.description: History and wildlife circular walk. Paths are flat and wide with a good solid surface. Dog friendly.

r.name: A Glimpse of Southern Clumber, Clumber Park
r.description: Clumber Lake, woodlands, history, wildlife. Clear paths, bridleways and woodland tracks. Some uneven surfaces. Not suitable for dogs, livestock in fields.

r.name: Clumber on the War Path Circular Walk, Clumber Park
r.description: This walk is dedicated to the men of Clumber who served and died in the Great War (1914–1918). Mostly clear paths through woodland and heathland, with some sections on roads. Slight to moderate gradients, uneven terrain.

r.name: Clumber Park Curiosities Long Walk, Clumber Park
r.description: Varied terrain, including paths, parkland, woodland and road. Includes steps, slight slopes and roadside grass verges. Dog Friendly.

r.name: Clumber Park Livestock-Free Walk, Clumber Park
r.description: Circular walk avoids areas of the park that may contain grazing livestock, so it's ideal for dog walking. Dog-friendly café, Central Bark. Generally good paths but may be muddy. For further details, please see Terrain section.

r.name: The Robin Hood Way, Clumber Park
r.description: Robin Hood Way, Circular Walk. Varied path surfaces and some gentle ascents. Dogs are welcome, on leads in certain areas of the park.

r.name: Clumber Park Waymarked Walk, Clumber Park
r.description: The circular route is marked with orange (one direction) and olive (reverse direction) waymarks. Varied terrain including heathland, woodland and grass verges. Includes slight slopes and some busy roads to cross. Not suitable for dogs.

r.name: Clumber Walk for All Seasons, Clumber Park
r.description: Circular walk. Clear paths through woodland and across heathland; slight to moderate uphill and downhill gradients. Dogs are welcome at Clumber Park. In certain areas, signs will ask visitors to put their dog on a lead.

r.name: Clumber Park Lakeside Walk, Clumber Park
r.description: Circular walk. Varied but mostly easy terrain. Dog friendly.

r.name: Northern Clumber Heath and Woods Walk, Clumber Park
r.description: Circular walk through heath and woodland. Good paths throughout but can be muddy in places. Dogs are welcome at Clumber. In busy areas, visitors will be asked to put them on a lead.

r.name: North West Clumber Walk: A Tale of Two Bridges, Clumber Park
r.description: Circular walk. Good paths but can be muddy in places. Dogs are welcome, on leads in certain areas of the park.

r.name: The Bluebell Woods of Clumber, Clumber Park
r.description: Circular route through wooded areas with bluebells in Spring. The route follows mainly flat tracks through woodland and fields. Some uneven ground, slight slopes and roads to cross. Dog friendly.

r.name: The Second World War Walk, Clumber Park
r.description: Explore sites of Second World War activities plus evidence of significant earthworks throughout Clumber Park. Some uneven surfaces and inclines. Dogs are welcome, on leads in certain areas of the park.

r.name: Worksop Walk, Mr Straw's House
r.description: Urban terrain through mostly residential areas. Option to walk through the churchyard to visit the Straw's graves, the churchyard has uneven grassy ground.
